notes.title: Demo Hotfix #3
notes.notes:
Hey, Christoffer Bodegård here!

This hotfix took a bit longer, mainly because I wanted to examine some errors properly. Big thank you to everyone reporting bugs on the Discord and the Steam discussions- it really helps a lot. 


 Some intense Dialog UI optimization. This should stabilize framerate in long dialogs, and make animations smoother in general.
 The quality settings now no longer reset whenever you open the settings.
 Exhaustion now properly updates as you load a save.
 The Seagull dialog will now react properly if you looted the Plume of Righteousness before attempting to pet the bird.
 The PPG Documents will now no longer be stuck, invisibly, in your inventory after returning them to Alfoz.
 In certain cases, items would despawn upon loading a save file. This should now be corrected.
 Fixed the instances of the mysterious elf magically disappearing if you take her esoteric rock.
 If you somehow manage to successfully punch 'The Duck', after failing to have a conversation about masculinity, you now won't get stuck in the encounter. Also, made the combat music actually play here.

notes.title: Demo Hotfix #2
notes.notes:
Hey, Christoffer Bodegård here!

Another quick hotfix! Turns out there was a very interesting error that could occur if you played with a very specific set of ability score combos.


 Fixed a freeze that happened after the intro, if you made a Cleric with low DEX and somewhat high INT.

notes.title: Demo Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Hey, Christoffer Bodegård here!

Thank you to everyone playing the demo! And especially thank you for the reported bugs: I've pushed a quick hotfix for some of the more pressing ones.


 Fixed a save game bug that set all stats to 6 when loading from the menu.
 Fixed a bug where pressing escape during a cutscene caused the player to get stuck in the sleeping animation.
 Save games were labelled as currentDay + 1, instead of just currentDay. Fixed.
 The Cleric started with an apple, instead of starting with no apple. The Cleric will have to work for his apples.
 Various minor UI bug fixes
 Various minor save system bug fixes

notes.title: Hotfix #4
notes.notes:
Hey! Quick hotfix for some major reported bugs. Thanks to everyone posting in the Steam discussions and the Discord. Your feedback is extremely valuable!

FIXES

Fixed a bug not letting your equipment alter your stats in dice rolls and passive checks.
Unlocking dice checks with Shard of Jor will not lock the dialog choices, so you can't softlock yourself by pressing numbers on your keyboard.
Made a the trap trigger once, instead of several times.
Removed the infinite snail loot stash exploit. The economy will recover.
Tons of spelling erors fixed. [sic]

OTHER CHANGES

UI changes, all visual.
Added a short rest button.
A walk marker, marking where you'll walk as you click.
Added the exhaustion system.

notes.title: Hotfix #1-3
notes.notes:
Hey, Christoffer Bodegård here!

I want to thank everyone who's played the demo since release last week. Especially thank you to all of you who've reported bugs! So far I've posted three hotfixes to deal with various errors, weird behaviors, unlootable entities, and respawning lootable entities. They should be taken care of now. If you find any additional esoteric errors, crashes, or weirdness, please report them to me, or post them on the official Discord. Thanks! 

FIXES

Snell no longer gets stuck on stairs.
Items should now no longer be visible after pickup.
Loading from in-game should now no longer break your inventory.
The inventory-doesn't-show-up-sometimes-bug has been solved.
The unclickable pots are now no longer highlighted.
The sword's lootbox is now in the correct spot, instead of slightly off-center. No one reported this, but I found it really annoying.
The Circle Square Conflict Take Root dialog should now no longer softlock the game.
A ton of speling erors are corected. [sic]
